findings.summary: Flag misses permission errors from directory traversal (haystack.rs build_from_result), so the common case still prints and exits 2
Scratch files pullrequest.txt and purpose.txt committed at repo root
handle_search_error calls set_errored() directly against the comment in messages.rs
New unit tests race on a process-global ERRORED static and one test cannot fail; no integration test
--suppress-error=permission duplicates --no-messages, which already suppresses these errors; confusing value names
Flag/field placement out of alphabetical order and local style differs from --color
zsh completion lists no values and sits in the wrong exclusion group
PR body overstates test coverage and has a broken list

why: Finding 5 states that --no-messages already exists and hides these errors so the new flag duplicates it, which matches the maintainer's reason; it also names the one residual difference (exit status) but still calls it a duplicate. Verdict is 'Wouldn't merge as is' without saying close, so changes.
